messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: trouble installing rstan 2.14.1 on Yosemite
parts:
On Wednesday, March 8, 2017 at 9:21:38 PM UTC-5, Blaine Mooers wrote:
** preparing package for lazy loading
Error in setMethod("traceplot", signature = "stanfit", function(object,  : 
  no existing definition for function ‘traceplot’
Error : unable to load R code in package ‘rstan’
ERROR: lazy loading failed for package ‘rstan’
* removing ‘/Users/blaine-mooers/Library/R/3.3/library/rstan/libs/rstan’
Warning in install.packages :
  installation of package ‘rstan’ had non-zero exit status

My guess is that you have some other package loaded that exports a traceplot() function. In

https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/blob/develop/rstan/rstan/R/stanfit-class.R#L592

it tests whether there is a S4 generic function called traceplot before creating one.

If you start R with the --vanilla option, installation of rstan may work (although you should be able to install the binary version from CRAN rather than building from source).

Ben

https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/blob/develop/rstan/rstan/R/stanfit-class.R#L592

Ben
